system.description:
May they be an appraiser of rare magic items, peddler of illicit substances, or bookkeeper for the court, merchants are masters of exchange.


Iconic Merchants

• Anna, Fire Emblem

• Marco Polo, Venetian merchant

• Torneko Taloon, Dragon Quest IV

• Tressa Colzione, Octopath Traveler


Playing Merchant

The merchant is a low-defense and damage character, who provides high-support through a wider inventory pool and optimizing your

party’s resources. In combat, you should look out for allies in need of assistance and strategize what items to use.


Action: Use

Move: Flexible (skip to Use)


Training: Craft, Influence

features.name: Deep Pockets
features.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk (p. 68), and you have extra Item Slots equal to (half your Level, round up).

features.name: Gold Sink
features.description: You can take the Use Action to place non-Relic Items into a container, close it, then choose an Item with a value no more than the original valuables’. The chosen Item replaces the valuables.

features.name: Bang for Your Buck
features.description: When you Use an Item with limited uses, you can spend 1 Luck and roll a d12. If the result is lower than your remaining Luck, the Item is not expended. This die size decreases every 6 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Anitquarian
features.description: You can spend a Shift to either remove one Power from a non-Fabled Relic in your possession or expend valuables of equal or higher value to the Power to add it to an Item.

features.name: Diamond Hands
features.description: Any Relic Item Bonus or Rank is increased by 1 while you have it Equipped.

features.name: Bang for Your Buck
features.description: When you Use an Item with limited uses, you can spend 1 Luck and roll a d10. If the result is lower than your remaining Luck, the Item is not expended.

features.name: Top Shelf
features.description:
Once per Week, you can pull a non-Fabled Relic from your Gold Sink Feature with a value no higher than (your Level × 200g), otherwise

obeying all the rules for that Feature.
